hungry.feeding: When you eat food, the fullness gauge increases. Each time fullness is restored, intimacy goes up.
I like apple juice, but each pet eats different food.
hungry.hunting: When a monster’s HP drops, the chance to capture it as a pet increases!
Items used to turn monsters into pets are often obtained by hunting the monster you want to capture. Not always, though...
hungry.danger: Be careful! If the master dies, intimacy with the master decreases as well.
Just as the master needs potions, I need food too.
hungry.dead: Pets do not die, but if intimacy becomes too low, they will leave the master.
Intimacy decreases when the master dies, when you feed too much food, or when you leave the pet hungry.
hungry.stand: If you want to feed me, right-click on me and select “Feed.”
I only drink apple juice.
Accessories can be purchased from the Taming Merchant.
They can be used to decorate your pet.
Pet accessories do not provide any stats; they just make your pet look nicer.
hungry.connect: Welcome, Master. I am a rookie Poring who will introduce pets to you.
Please keep a close eye on the fullness gauge. When the pet is hungry, intimacy will gradually decrease.
hungry.levelup: Pets do not level up, but when intimacy increases, they can support the master with abilities.
When you eat food while hungry, intimacy increases, and as intimacy increases, the abilities provided also become stronger!
hungry.perfor_1: Performances can only be seen when a pet is in the “Best Friend” state. I am an exception because I am a guide!
hungry.perfor_2: Through performances, you can see the unique personalities of monsters that have become pets. These are sides you could not see when they were monsters.
hungry.perfor_3: Performances do not serve any functional purpose. They simply show our different sides.
hungry.perfor_s: Some monsters do not have performances. They may be blunt friends, but please cherish them anyway.

bit_hungry.feeding: If you feed them when they are slightly hungry, intimacy increases the most.
When they are hungry, intimacy drops, so be sure to feed them before they get hungry.
bit_hungry.hunting: Choco is sometimes given Tropical Bananas. With Tropical Bananas, you can capture a Yoyo.
Hode and Condor are given Plump Earthworms. It’s the favorite food for taming a Peco Peco!
bit_hungry.danger: Be careful! If the master dies, intimacy with the master decreases as well.
Just as the master needs potions, I need food too.
bit_hungry.dead: Pets do not die, but if intimacy becomes too low, they will leave the master’s side.
Intimacy decreases when the master dies, when you feed too much food, or when you leave them hungry and unattended.
bit_hungry.stand: If you want to feed me, right-click me and choose Feed. I only drink apple juice.
The only way to raise intimacy is to feed food. But if you feed when they are full, intimacy actually goes down.
Intimacy increases in this order: Distant, Awkward, Normal, Close, Best Friend.
A Best Friend pet adds stats for the master. Also, it can evolve.
I can’t evolve.. because I’m just a guide.
When a Poring becomes a Best Friend, it can evolve into a Mastering. When a Mastering becomes a Best Friend, it can evolve into an Angeling.
When a pet evolves, its stats are strengthened! It can help the master even more.

noting.feeding: Even at a normal time, eating food increases intimacy. But it increases less than when they’re hungry.
Feeding them consistently whenever they return to normal is the fastest way to become close. But it takes a lot of food..
noting.hunting: Poporing can be captured with Bitter Herb. When you hunt Green Herb, Bitter Herb sometimes appears.
Desert Wolf Babies like a Well-Dried Bone. It’s a bone that Pirate Skeleton sometimes gives.
noting.danger: Be careful! If the master dies, intimacy with the master decreases as well.
Just as the master needs potions, I need food too.
noting.dead: Pets do not die, but if intimacy becomes too low, they will leave the master’s side.
Intimacy decreases when the master dies, when you feed too much food, or when you leave them hungry and unattended.
noting.stand: If you want to feed me, right-click me and choose Feed. I only drink apple juice.
If you right-click me and select View Pet Status, you can see various information about me.
My original name is Rookie Poring, but if you want, you can give me a new nickname.
When intimacy becomes Best Friend, the evolution menu appears. I can’t evolve because I’m only a guide…
If you return me to an egg, I go into the Equipment tab of the master’s inventory.
To hatch a pet, you need a Portable Egg Incubator. It’s sold in each town, but it costs 10,000 zeny.
After returning me to an egg, you can send me to another master. Even if I go to another master, my name and intimacy stay the same.

full.feeding: When you’re full, you must not feed food. Your intimacy will go down.
The easiest way for your pet to leave is to keep feeding it when it’s full.. Please don’t hate it too much just because it’s picky.
full.hunting: Pet Exchange Coupons that you can sometimes get from events contain various pet-capturing items.
When a pet evolves, it requires various items. If you click a Best Friend pet that can evolve, you can check the materials.
full.danger: Be careful! If the master dies, intimacy with the master will drop as well.
As long as the master doesn’t die, intimacy will not decrease even if you fight a lot.
full.dead: Pets do not die, but if intimacy becomes too low, they will leave the master’s side.
Intimacy decreases when the master dies, when you feed too much food, or when you leave the pet hungry and unattended.
full.stand: When you’re full, don’t feed food. Intimacy will actually decrease.
If intimacy doesn’t reach Best Friend, the pet won’t say anything. I’m an exception because I’m a guide!
If intimacy is low, the pet may leave the master.. Please be careful. I’m a guide, so I won’t leave.
In the “distant” state, even if you feed it, it doesn’t look very pleased. But inside, it’s grateful.
Pet Food is feed that many pets like. Be sure to give it when they’re hungry.
Pet accessories, Pet Food, and Portable Egg Incubators are sold by the Taming Merchant in each town.
I wish I could evolve into a Poring too.. Level up from Rookie!

so_full.hunting: If you got a pet-capturing item, use it and then click the monster you want to capture. If “Success” appears, you succeeded!
You can also exchange pet-capturing items by giving items to NPCs in Alberta, Izlude, and Comodo.

so_full.stand: When you’re full, don’t feed food. Intimacy will actually decrease.
How to capture well? It’s better if the monster’s HP is low, but other than that, it’s nothing but luck..
Evolved pets can auto-feed! But if you leave them unattended and let your guard down, it’s a problem when the feed runs out.
With evolved pets, intimacy decreases slowly. But raising intimacy is also difficult.
Some pets can evolve into two different kinds of pets. Depending on what monster they transform into, the materials also change.
After evolution, the pet becomes distant and hungry. Change must always be hard..

hungry.feeding: Hooang~ Today’s menu, what’s the menu? Isn’t there something like sweet pumpkin pie?
I’m hungry... Are you trying to starve me to death? My dad never let me go hungry.
Bat eyeballs, mole tails, snake tongues... Yeah, what is this? It’s Lori Ruri’s special medicine that makes you forget hunger... Ah, I’m hungry...
hungry.hunting: You throw noisy kids down to the bottom of the Niflheim cliff. So they can never chatter again.
Hooang, it’s a fight! Attack! Hurry and go out and show a cool and dependable 모습. Like my master should.
Those guys look like they could become good ingredients for the medicine Lori Ruri makes. What kind of medicine? That’s a se~cret.
hungry.danger: You can’t chug potions because they’re a waste? Don’t worry—I’ll make you the finest tonic made from bat eyeballs.
You’re not going to disappear and leave me behind, right? If you leave me alone, I’ll write your name on a straw doll and bite it to shreds.
hungry.dead: Wait. For times like this, Lori Ruri’s special awakening potion that snaps you wide awake... Ah—seems like there isn’t any.
So weak! Pathetic! This kind of person is my master?
Kuru... Should Lori Ruri go find a new master now?
hungry.stand: Have you seen the toad powder I left here? I put it away carefully when I was sleeping earlier... Huh? Of course, in the master’s pocket.
Me... I heard something like this once. Witch, evil girl... I didn’t do anything... Am I really a bad child?
Among my friends in Niflheim, I’m reminded of a big, strong friend who doesn’t talk and isn’t cute at all. They were amazing at ripping things up with a kitchen knife, stabbing and stabbing.
Do you like cats? Lori Ruri wants a male cat. A black one with pretty eyes... Surely it would need a friend... right? Kuru
Lori Ruri doesn’t remember her birthday. If it’s okay, I think it’d be good to set the day I first met the master as my new birthday. Ahem.
hungry.connect: Why are you only coming now! If you make me bored, is it even fun?
I was enjoying some alone time for once, but if the master wants, I can play with you.
It’s not like I was waiting for you. I’m Lori Ruri, who does just fine on my own...
hungry.levelup: Hooang~ Now that you’ve gotten sturdier, you’ve got more energy to play with me too, right? Right?
Now you kind of look a little more like a master who suits me... Heh.
hungry.perfor_1: Hwaaam... stop... I can’t eat anymoreyng... kuuu...
hungry.perfor_2: Kuru has to exercise too. If you keep lying face-down like that, you’ll end up like that master over there...
Kuru needs friends too. Right, Kuru? You’re bored too, aren’t you?
hungry.perfor_3: The crescent moon quietly shines on me~ My reflection in the cold lake at dawn~ I am moonlight girl Lori Ruri~♬

hungry.feeding: You really are hopeless, aren’t you?
Next time, give it to me faster. Do you want me to leave you?
hungry.hunting: You look strong, but.. that’s not your limit, right?
Yes, that’s exactly what I’m telling you to do.
hungry.danger: Isn’t it a little.. dangerous?
What are you doing right now? I’d rather control you like a puppet.
You’re right that it’s dangerous, but I’m hungry!
How many times do I have to tell you? Do it properly, will you?
hungry.dead: Hah.. Pathetic—sticking your nose into the ground from something like this.
How stupid do you have to be to look pathetic to a puppet doll?
What are you even doing? Can’t you get up?
.......Don’t give up..... Stand up.
hungry.stand: Who.. am I? Where.. is this?
You won’t ignore me just because I’m a doll, will you?
Right now, you’re all I have..
Are you ignoring me on purpose? Or...
hungry.connect: Why did you come so late?
Don’t leave me alone..
Even if it’s only sometimes, take me to the Geffen Dungeon.. I miss my friends.
hungry.levelup: Oh? You’re amazing, aren’t you?
But don’t let your guard down. You’re not the only one getting stronger.
I told you, didn’t I? The fruit of patience is bitter..
hungry.perfor_2: Sometimes I miss my friends too..
I wonder if Whisper and Nightmare are doing well?

bit_hungry.feeding: Do you think I wouldn’t get hungry just because I’m a doll?
Timing is important in everything..
Take care of me.. Hmph!
It’s a relief you’re taking care of me now, at least.
bit_hungry.hunting: It’s good that you work hard.. but couldn’t you take care of me first?
I’m hungry...
If you defeat that guy, can I eat?
bit_hungry.danger: What are you doing? Put some 힘 into it!!
First, let’s get out of danger—I'm not saying we should run away!
Me too.. but you too.. honestly..
bit_hungry.dead: If you had listened to me, this wouldn’t have happened, would it?
It’s okay.. It’s not like the world ended or anything..
Next time, don’t scare me like this.
bit_hungry.stand: I’m hungry..

so_full.dead: You're not already asleep, are you?
Huh? Why did you suddenly lie down?
Please come back. This isn't over yet.
so_full.stand: If you stand still much longer, the snow will start piling up on you.
I'm bored. Shall we build a snowman?
If you don't move soon, I'm going to start throwing snow first.
so_full.connect: Ta-da! I rode in on a snowstorm!
so_full.levelup: Congratulations on leveling up! Shall I celebrate with a little snowfall?

so_full.hunting: Nice! That was a perfectly clean finish!
I knew tagging along with you was a good idea!
so_full.danger: Get out of there! You're making me nervous!
Forget looking cool—staying safe comes first!
so_full.dead: Aw, so close! Let's give it another shot!
Come on, shake it off and get back up!
Eh, you just had bad luck this time!
so_full.stand: Ready to get moving?
Think there's anything fun we could do?
All this standing around is making me sleepy too.
so_full.connect: Let's have another great day together!
so_full.levelup: Congrats on leveling up! I've got a good feeling about this!

so_full.hunting: You're absolutely on fire today!
Wow, now you've got me all excited too!
so_full.danger: It's okay to tuck your tail and run right now!
Danger alert! Wee-oo, wee-oo!
so_full.dead: Huh? It's over already?
Stop pretending to sleep and come play with me!
That's not fair! Get back up!
so_full.stand: I'm bored! Wanna go run a lap?
Pay attention to me! I've been waiting so long my tail might fall off!
Treats or walkies? Hurry up and pick one!
so_full.connect: I came running the second you called, tail wagging and all!
so_full.levelup: You leveled up! Clap, clap, clap!

so_full.hunting: Wow, I bet those enemies are cooked to a perfect golden brown!
That performance was delicious even without any sauce!
so_full.danger: Keep pushing yourself and you'll burn to a crisp!
It's dangerous! Grab one of my legs and get out of there!
so_full.dead: Don't tell me you collapsed from being overcooked.
Get up! There's still time to turn this around!
Oh dear… I think this one's a little too burnt.
so_full.stand: If you keep standing there, should I flip you over myself?
I'm bored. Want to count how many legs I have?
At this rate, even I'm going to get cold. Let's get moving!
so_full.connect: All ready! My legs may be short, but I got here fast!
so_full.levelup: I can feel a new power! I didn't grow any extra legs, did I?

so_full.hunting: What a delightfully sweet finish.
The enemies must have dropped like a pile of toppings.
so_full.danger: Please get out of there! You're about to melt like whipped cream!
Push yourself any harder and you'll lose all your toppings!
so_full.dead: Don't tell me you've melted away like cream.
Am I supposed to keep pretending to be a cat all by myself?
Meow… This is more than a little disappointing.
so_full.stand: If you keep staring, my toppings are going to melt.
I'm bored. Would you like to see my cat impression?
Are you counting my toppings one by one?
so_full.connect: You finally called! I even brought all my toppings!
so_full.levelup: Congratulations! You've grown even sweeter than before.

so_full.hunting: Hey, not bad. You interested in joining my crew?
That's it? I didn't even have time to mess up my pompadour.
so_full.danger: Keep showing off like that and you're gonna get seriously hurt.
Knowing when to back off is a skill too.
so_full.dead: Don't lie down like that. You're gonna ruin your pompadour.
Get up. We've got our crew's reputation to protect.
I'll pretend I didn't see that, so hurry up and get over here.
so_full.stand: If you've got nothing to do, you could at least comb my hair.
Haven't you stared at my pompadour long enough?
Get moving. I'm starting to get bored.
so_full.connect: You'd better not have called me for something lame.
so_full.levelup: Moved up another rank, huh? At least you upheld our crew's reputation.

so_full.hunting: You're not hurt, are you? Good. That's all that matters.
That hunt was easier than organizing the groceries.
so_full.danger: Get out of there. Don't make me tell you twice.
Don't wait until you're hurt to regret it.
so_full.dead: I told you not to overdo it.
I'll keep this little incident a secret from the family.
Next time, please listen to what I tell you.
so_full.stand: If you're just going to stand there, you could at least go grocery shopping.
If you've got nothing to do, you can help carry the bags.
Staring into space won't make the chores disappear.
so_full.connect: I was in the middle of shopping, but I made a special trip for you.
so_full.levelup: Now that's something worth bragging about to the family.

so_full.hunting: Whew… I can finally relax.
I was only watching, but somehow I'm completely exhausted.
so_full.danger: That looks really dangerous. Please be careful…
I don't think you can hold out much longer like this.
so_full.dead: Please don't leave me here all alone…
You can get back up, right…?
Next time, please don't push yourself so hard…
so_full.stand: It's so quiet… I suppose that's a little comforting.
Would it be all right if I rested beside you?
Doesn't standing there for so long make you tired?
so_full.connect: I'm happy you came looking for me.
so_full.levelup: Seeing you grow stronger puts my mind at ease.

so_full.hunting: Hehe, over already? Didn't even get a chance to cause trouble this time!
so_full.danger: Whoa! This is way past joking around!
Careful! If you go down, who am I supposed to play with?
so_full.dead: You're just pretending to be down, right? I'm not falling for it!
If you leave me all alone, I might get into even more trouble!
Huh? Wait, this isn't the prank I had in mind…
so_full.stand: Hey, look at me! I'm cuter than a Baby Poring, right?
I'm bored… Can I play just one little prank?
Keep ignoring me and I'll poke you with my wings!
so_full.connect: Ta-da! The adorable Baby Luchi is here!
so_full.levelup: Nice! Now you can handle even bigger trouble!

so_full.hunting: Already over? That was quicker than I expected.
It'd be so convenient if the food just came to us on its own.
so_full.danger: Don't push yourself too hard. It'd be awful if you got eaten.
Why not hide somewhere nice and cozy, like me?
so_full.dead: Huh… Did you really get eaten?
Come back soon. I'll save you a spot.
Lie there too long and someone might mistake you for food.
so_full.stand: Let's stay a little longer. I finally found the perfect position.
Food comes to me, the rain stays out… What more could I need?
I'm not trapped. I'm resting.
so_full.connect: I was relaxing so comfortably… What's going on?
so_full.levelup: You're stronger now, so you can do the moving for me.

so_full.hunting: Being with you makes me feel like my missing half is finally filled in.
Bet those enemies split in half and ran away, too!
so_full.danger: We should stick close together right now.
Quick, get out of there! I'd hate for us to get separated!
so_full.dead: You didn't leave me with only half of you, did you?
Huh… Did I lose my other half again?
Don't leave me all alone like this. It feels so empty.
so_full.stand: Is there someone you're waiting for? Me too, actually.
Could you be waiting for your other half, too?
I see something round over there… Mind if I go check it out?
so_full.connect: You found me. Maybe it was meant to be.
so_full.levelup: You've grown! I think we're an even better match now!

so_full.hunting: Think the enemies got scared of me first?
Oh, we made it through in one piece again. What a relief!
so_full.danger: Get out of there! What if you end up all tattered like me?
Danger! Let's worry about everything else after you survive!
so_full.dead: Huh… You're the one lying down this time?
It's okay, I got back up too. You can do it!
Huh… You're the one lying down this time?
so_full.stand: Don't just stand there. Let's do something before my joints seize up!
Let's do something. When it's too quiet, I start getting creeped out.
If I don't move, my body gets even stiffer!
so_full.connect: Made it here in one piece again today. Mostly!
so_full.levelup: You're getting pretty sturdy! You look more alive than I do.

so_full.hunting: Krrroong, papapat! …That means 'great job.'
That victory was thanks to cosmic energy. Probably.
so_full.danger: Beep-beep-beep! Your life signs are getting weaker!
Careful! Even cosmic energy can't fix this!
so_full.dead: Huh… Your life signal just disappeared.
Lie there like that and I'll classify you as an unidentified life-form!
This situation is hard to explain even in alien.
so_full.stand: Let's get moving. These coordinates are getting boring.
Bweee-reep… I just picked up a signal from space. What it said is classified.
Keep standing still and I'm registering you as an observation subject.
so_full.connect: Summoning signal received! UFOring has arrived!
so_full.levelup: Level up! Your antenna reception is looking great, too!
